items.title: 23.9 Hydrolysis of Acyl Chlorides, Alkyl Chlorides and Aryl Chlorides (acyl, alkyl aur aryl chlorides ka paani se tootna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 23.9 with Quick Check 23.5 (answers need review), printed pages 111-112 (PDF 114-115).

blocks.text: Acyl chlorides, alkyl chlorides aur aryl (arene) chlorides ki reactivity (react karne ki tezi) ka comparison (muqabla) is baat se kiya ja sakta hai ke yeh kitni aasani se hydrolyse hote hain. Yeh reactions dekhein:

blocks.alt: Paani ke saath teen reactions. Ethanoyl chloride, CH3-C(=O)-Cl, + H2O, 'Room temperature, rapid', se ethanoic acid + HCl. Chloroethane, CH3-CH2-Cl, + H2O, 'Heat under reflux', se ethanol + HCl. Chlorobenzene + H2O: No Reaction.
blocks.caption: Ethanoyl chloride, chloroethane aur chlorobenzene ki hydrolysis (kitab ke page 114 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen reactions aik saath: ethanoyl chloride room temperature par foran paani se react karta hai; chloroethane ko reflux par garam karna parta hai; chlorobenzene paani se bilkul react nahi karta. Order (tarteeb): acyl chloride > alkyl chloride > aryl chloride.

Ethanoyl chloride mein carbonyl carbon par kafi partial positive charge hota hai, kyun ke us se seedhe do bohat electronegative atoms, oxygen aur chlorine, jure hain jo electrons zor se kheenchte hain. Is liye H₂O electrophilic carbon par itni tezi se nucleophilic attack karta hai ke reaction kuch minutes mein complete ho jata hai.

Ethyl chloride (chloroethane) mein carbon sirf aik chlorine atom se jura hai, is liye us par comparatively (nisbatan) kam partial positive charge hota hai. Is liye paani ka nucleophilic attack aahista hota hai, aur kitab ke mutabiq 100 °C par bhi reaction complete hone mein 14 din lagte hain.

Chlorobenzene mein chlorine se jura carbon benzene ring ka hissa hai. Yahan chlorine ka lone pair ring ke π electrons ke saath delocalization (phailao) mein shamil ho jata hai. Is se C–Cl bond mein kuch double bond character (double bond jaisi khoobi) aa jati hai aur bond itna mazboot ho jata hai ke nahi toot'ta, is liye chlorobenzene reaction mein hissa nahi leta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'π elections' chhapa hai; sahi 'π electrons' hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Phenols carboxylic acids se seedhe react kar ke phenyl esters kyun nahi banate?
blocks.explanation: Phenol ke oxygen ka lone pair benzene ring mein delocalised hai, is liye phenol weak nucleophile hai aur carboxylic acid ke kam electrophilic carbon par theek se attack nahi kar pata. Is liye zyada reactive acyl chloride istemal kiya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Ethanoyl chloride aur phenol se phenyl ethanoate banane ki equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: CH₃COCl + C₆H₅OH → CH₃COOC₆H₅ + HCl (halka garam karein; NaOH jaisa base phenoxide ion bana kar madad deta hai).

blocks.prompt: c) Products batayein aur equations likhein: (i) chlorobenzene aur ethanol; (ii) propanoyl chloride aur phenol.
blocks.explanation: (i) Koi reaction nahi: chlorobenzene ka C–Cl bond bohat mazboot hai. (ii) CH₃CH₂COCl + C₆H₅OH → CH₃CH₂COOC₆H₅ + HCl (phenyl propanoate).

items: Ethanoyl chloride: room temperature par tez hydrolysis (C par O aur Cl dono).
Chloroethane: aahista, reflux par garam karna parta hai.
Chlorobenzene: koi reaction nahi (Cl ka lone pair ring mein delocalised, C–Cl mazboot).
Order (tarteeb): acyl chloride > alkyl chloride > aryl chloride.
